name: Drei Grafen
kurzbeschreibung:
**Three Counts in Tirol** --- **

Discover Tirol’s Royal Heritage

** In the heart of the **Alps**, the fairy-tale world of **Tirol** unfolds—where medieval castles, alpine meadows, and the spirit of three legendary counts still linger. Step into a time of knights, intrigue, and breathtaking landscapes as you explore the legacy of **Graf Meinhard II**, **Graf Heinrich von Tirol**, and **Graf Sigmund der Münzreiche**. --- **

Graf Meinhard II – The Visionary

** In the 13th century, **Graf Meinhard II** laid the foundation for Tirol’s golden age. His vision transformed the region into a powerful duchy, connecting **Innsbruck** with the **Reschenpass** and securing Tirol’s place in European history. Today, his legacy lives on in the **Hofburg Innsbruck**, where the **Goldene Halle** (Golden Hall) still shimmers with imperial grandeur. --- **

Graf Heinrich von Tirol – The Warrior

** A fearless leader and master strategist, **Graf Heinrich von Tirol** expanded Tirol’s borders in the 14th century. His campaigns in **Italy** and **Switzerland** earned him the title *"Heinrich der Löwe"* (Henry the Lion). Visit the **Burg Tratzberg**, his former stronghold, where the echoes of battles and royal feasts still resonate. --- **

Graf Sigmund der Münzreiche – The Innovator

** In the 15th century, **Graf Sigmund der Münzreiche** revolutionized Tirol’s economy with the introduction of the **Gulden**, a currency that shaped trade across Europe. His castle, **Burg Tirol** in **Meran**, stands as a testament to his foresight—and his love for **Kaiserschmarrn**, a dish still cherished in Tirol’s cozy **Gasthöfe**. --- **

Follow in Their Footsteps

** From the **Inntal** to the **Zillertal**, Tirol’s medieval trails invite you to relive the era of its three greatest counts. Whether you’re sipping **Tiroler Apfelstrudel** in a rustic **Hütte** or admiring the **Nordkette** from **Innsbruck’s** old town, every moment is a journey through history. --- **

Plan Your Royal Adventure

** - **Castle Hopping:** Explore **Burg Tratzberg**, **Burg Tirol**, and **Hofburg Innsbruck**. - **Culinary Delights:** Taste **Kaiserschmarrn**, **Gröstl**, and **Tiroler Speckknödel** in historic taverns. - **Scenic Routes:** Drive the **Reschenpass** or hike the **Alpenrosenweg** for panoramic views. --- **

Tirol Awaits – Where Legends Come to Life

** **

Book your journey today and step into the world of Tirol’s three counts.
